description: We are Phoenix Protocol, a group of passionate A-Level students from Lahore Grammar School, Johar Town (LGS JT), Pakistan. United by our interests in science, technology, and innovation, we aim to tackle real-world challenges through research, creativity, and collaborative problem-solving. Through PyroScale, we hope to demonstrate how young innovators can harness NASA's Earth observation data and emerging technologies to develop meaningful solutions with global impact.
